title: AUTUMN AGAIN
author: Snehaprava Das
text:
I stand waiting
By this cold, indifferent gate
That opens to nowhere,
Nothing happens around
No body comes
No body goes
The sky hangs like
A canopy of pale silence
Over a degenerating landscape,
And the sun rests gentle on the
Rusting autumn bones,

I stand waiting here,
For one lost moment
That holds death in it
To come alive,

I wait for the moment to return
Like a trickle of tear returning
To the corner of the eye,
Like a drop of blood spilled once
Making its way back to the stiffened vein,
Like a fallen star climbing up
To the sky of an endless night,
Like a forbidden breath crawling back into
An ancient grave,

I know no body will come
No body will go
Nothing will happen
Except for that one forgotten moment
Returning to settle stubborn
In my autumn mood,
So I stand waiting here
For that moment to arrive

In this yellowing solitude!
